Zoe (CS): Day0 handshake for SignalBridge private deploy. Top open items: egress allowlist, runtime SA for model pulls (S3/GCS), KMS key ACL + rotation plan, audit/logs -> Splunk with mTLS + HMAC. @Dmitri can you own SA + firewall? :wave:
Dmitri (NetOps): On it. What will the SA be called and where are models stored?
signalops-bot: Runbook created: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/signalbridge-week0 — egress IPs we usually request: 35.196.0.0/14, 34.120.0.0/14. See dynamic egress list in the runbook. Ports: 443 and 15010 (metrics).
Zoe (CS): SA: `signalbridge-rw` in project `signalbridge-prod`. Models in GCS `gs://sb-models` and S3 `s3://sb-models-sync`. Need read-only pull for runtime.
Dmitri (NetOps): Plan to grant `roles/storage.objectViewer` for GCS and configure a cross-account role for S3 mirror. I will apply roles once SA exists. Hannah, what's the KMS cadence?
Hannah (Security): Rotation per contract: every 90 days. Key resource: `projects/signalbridge-prod/locations/global/keyRings/sb-kr/cryptoKeys/sb-main`. Policy should bind `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` to Redwood runtime SA and `roles/cloudkms.viewer` to `group:signalbridge-security@signalbridge.example.com`. Note retention exception: 420 days for audit logs on this account. Do not post secrets here.
Ibrahim (SRE): Splunk endpoint: `https://ingest.splunk.signalbridge.example/services/collector`. We require mTLS (client cert), TLS1.2+, and HMAC-SHA256 header `X-SB-Signature` for integrity. Please upload CSR or client cert and a sample JSON event to the secure handoff doc so we can validate.
Zoe (CS): Sample event (we will upload to secure handoff doc): ```json
{"ts":"2026-04-05T10:30:00Z","service":"sb-agent","event":{"type":"model.pull","model":"sb-3b","status":"ok","bytes":45210}}
```
Dmitri (NetOps): I will create the SA today, post the IAM diff here, and DM the CSR to the secure doc. Also will request the egress whitelist with NetOps.
Ibrahim (SRE): :thumbsup: I'll spin up a staging ingest endpoint to validate mapping after the sample is uploaded.
Zoe (CS): Action recap: 1) Dmitri to create SA, apply IAM, and request egress; 2) Hannah to review & sign KMS policy + rotation; 3) Ibrahim to validate Splunk mTLS + HMAC and confirm parsing; 4) signalops-bot runbook link kept up to date. Target: EOD next business day PST. Any blockers?
